text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Crosses the finish line!! First place 
goes to Kitasan Black, it's Kitasan 
Black!!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"This is truly the Kitasan Festival!! She 
magnificently claims the first leg of the 
Spring Senior Spring Triple Crown!!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aaaall right, HELL YEAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOH!! KITASAN BLACK---!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Congraaaats!! I'll definitely be there to 
cheer you on next time too~!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —...! Everyone—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best!! I'll train hard, and 
hard, and harder, and next time too, for 
sure...!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...They got me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Still, there's no panic. ...I am certain 
of it.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(I must keep moving forward. Beyond this 
lies—the glory I seek...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I'm home, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Welcome back, Crown. Good work out there.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Thanks. ...Ah, they got me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Still, the stage for your revenge has been 
properly set, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Because she's aiming for the Spring 
Senior Triple Crown. —She'll be coming to 
the Takarazuka Kinen, no doubt."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Settling things with Duramente-san. And 
getting my revenge against Kitasan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Let's fulfill them all. At the upcoming 
Takarazuka Kinen!

Though she suffered defeat, there was no 
trace of gloom on her face.

Satono Crown, now fully confident in her 
own weapons and strength, stood on footing 
that would waver no longer.

"Let's prepare thoroughly as we always 
have, and head out. âToward the 
Takarazuka Kinen."
